camel_example: aliyun imm CreateCustomizedStory --region cn-hangzhou --StoryName name1 --Cover '{"URI":"oss://test-bucket/test-object.jpg"}' --ProjectName immtest --DatasetName dataset001 --StorySubType Solo --StoryType PeopleMemory --Files '[{"URI":"URI_:_oss://test-bucket/test-object_1.jpg_,_URI_:_oss://test-bucket/test-object_2.jpg"}]'
description_en: Creates a story based on the specified images and videos
description_zh: 使用选择的图片和视频创建一个故事
kebab_example: aliyun imm create-customized-story --project-name immtest --dataset-name dataset001 --story-type PeopleMemory --story-sub-type Solo --story-name name1 --cover URI=oss://test-bucket/test-object.jpg --files URI=URI_:_oss://test-bucket/test-object_1.jpg_,_URI_:_oss://test-bucket/test-object_2.jpg --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateCustomizedStory

parameters.help_zh: 数据集名称。获取方式请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/478160.html
parameters.name: dataset_name

parameters.help_en: The type of the story. For information about valid types, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2743998.html
parameters.help_zh: 故事类型，指定需要生成相册故事的类型。具体类型描述和可取值请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2743998.html
parameters.name: story_type

parameters.help_en: The subtype of the story. For information about valid subtypes, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2743998.html
parameters.help_zh: 故事子类型，指定需要生成的相册故事的子类型，具体类型描述和可取值请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2743998.html
parameters.name: story_sub_type

fields.help_en: The URI of the cover image
fields.name: uri

parameters.help_en: The cover image of the story. You can specify an image as the cover image of the custom story
parameters.help_zh: 故事封面。用户可以指定一个图片作为自定义故事的封面
parameters.name: cover

parameters.help_en: The files of the story. You can specify up to 100 files in a custom story
parameters.help_zh: 自定义故事的文件列表，每个自定义故事最多支持100个文件
parameters.name: files

parameters.help_en: The custom labels. You can specify labels to help you identify and retrieve the story
parameters.help_zh: 自定义标签。该标签标记了用户对该故事自定义的信息，可作检索使用
parameters.name: custom_labels
